extra.message: The expr query parameter is evaluated as Python code. Removing __builtins__ does not prevent object-introspection sandbox escapes, allowing arbitrary code execution by callers possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

extra.message: The name query parameter is joined to BASE_EXPORT_DIR without checking path containment, then request.body is written there. cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The fragment query parameter becomes Jinja template source and is rendered without a sandbox. extra.message: prescription_edit restricts ownership only when the caller is a clinician. Patients and front-desk users pass this check and can POST changes to any known prescription UUID, including medication, dosage, instructions, refills_allowed, and patient ownership.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: AppointmentStaffForm accepts every patient and active provider without caller-specific restrictions. appointment_create and appointment_edit save this form for clinicians. A clinician can create an appointment for an unrelated patient, or move an existing appointment to that patient, setting themselves as provider. The resulting appointment satisfies the access checks in _patient_or_403 and grants access to the patient's chart and records.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: appointment_cancel checks patient ownership but never checks clinician ownership. A clinician can cancel another provider's appointment by POSTing its UUID, even though appointment_detail and appointment_edit reject that clinician.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: appointment_check_in permits every staff role and looks up the appointment solely by UUID. It does not enforce the clinician-provider restriction used by appointment_detail, allowing clinicians to change unrelated appointments to checked_in and replace their check-in timestamps.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: prescription_create saves the patient selected through PrescriptionForm, whose queryset includes every patient, without checking assignment or an existing appointment. A clinician can create prescriptions for unrelated patients despite the patient-access restrictions elsewhere.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: Staff uploads take patient_id directly from POST and save the document without checking the clinician's relationship to that patient. A clinician can insert documents into an unrelated patient's chart even when document_detail would deny access.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: document_verify checks only is_staff_role and retrieves any document by UUID. Clinicians can verify, reject, or archive documents belonging to unrelated patients without the assignment checks enforced by document_detail and document_download.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: message_create accepts any patient UUID for staff callers and saves the message without checking clinician assignment or appointments. Clinicians can send messages and insert internal notes into unrelated patients' records despite message_detail denying access to those patients.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: StaffPatientProfileForm exposes medical_notes, allergies, and blood_type as writable fields. patient_edit explicitly permits front-desk users and saves this form without field-level authorization, allowing demographic-management staff to alter clinical information.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: The JSON filter is passed directly to MongoDB find_one without restricting fields or query operators. Callers possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can submit operator-bearing queries to select arbitrary records, whose representation is returned. cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: copyline is concatenated into an HTML response without escaping. For requests passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate, supplied HTML and script execute when the response is rendered in the portal origin.

extra.message: The lane GET or POST parameter is passed directly to redirect without validating the destination host. Requests passing the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can redirect to an attacker-controlled external HTTPS URL.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: The operations handler logs the complete Authorization header and request body without redaction. Accepted requests can expose bearer credentials and submitted sensitive data to the console and rotating log file configured in settings.py.

extra.message: The length query parameter controls an unrestricted generation loop and string allocation. A caller possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can request an enormous length, exhausting worker CPU and memory with a small request.

extra.message: When DEBUG is enabled, which is the default, MEDIA_ROOT is served directly without authentication. cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: patient_list queries all patients for every staff role without enforcing the clinician relationship checks used by patient_detail. extra.message: user_toggle_active changes account status on GET because it has no POST requirement. An attacker knowing a target user UUID can induce a logged-in clinic administrator to navigate to the toggle URL, enabling or disabling that account without CSRF validation.

extra.message: appointment_cancel checks patient ownership but does not validate the current appointment status. extra.message: The CSV import reads the complete uploaded file into memory, decodes it, and constructs StringIO without checking file size. A permitted front-desk or administrator account can upload a large file that exhausts worker memory; ImportAppointmentsForm defines no size validator.

extra.message: Registration validates only password confirmation and passes the password to create_user, which does not invoke AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS. extra.message: The public login handler performs authentication on every POST without tracking failures, throttling, or locking accounts. No configured middleware or authentication backend supplies such protection, allowing unrestricted password guessing against patient and staff accounts.

extra.message: AuditMiddleware trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value from any requester without verifying a trusted proxy. Direct clients can choose the IP address subsequently persisted by log_action, falsifying the audit trail for logins, record access, and changes.
